column1: # This is the minimum maintained coverage for the six final domain audits. A row
# may belong to more than one audit when two perspectives are intentionally useful.
# Every applicable row is recorded by each owning audit as VERIFIED with evidence,
# or as INAPPLICABLE with a reason when this column explicitly permits it.
# Platform exception: REL-208 and REL-209 permit INAPPLICABLE with a specific
# Watch-only reason only when APP_PLATFORM=watchOS; their iOS policy stays no.
# domains: comma-separated values from functional, ui-ux, content, accessibility,
# allow_inapplicable: yes only when a product can genuinely lack the capability
#                     described by the row; an unavailable environment is not a
#                     reason to mark required coverage inapplicable
